mn140:30.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn140:31.1: asmīti bhikkhu maññitametaṃ nāhamasmīti maññitametaṃ bhavissanti maññitametaṃ na bhavissanti maññitametaṃ rūpī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ arūpī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ saññī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ asaññī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ nevasaññīnāsaññī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ.
mn140:31.2: maññitaṃ bhikkhu rogo maññitaṃ gaṇḍo maññitaṃ sallaṃ.
mn140:31.3: sabbamaññitānaṃ tveva bhikkhu samatikkamā muni santoti vuccati.
mn140:31.4: muni kho pana bhikkhu santo na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na kuppati nappiheti. tampissa
mn140:31.5: bhikkhu natthi yena jāyetha ajāyamāno kiṃ jiyyissati ajiyyamāno kiṃ miyyissati amiyyamāno kiṃ kuppissati akuppamāno kissa pihessati.
mn140:32.1: yattha ṭhitaṃ maññassavā nappavattanti maññassave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santoti vuccatīti
mn140:32.2: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn140:32.3: imaṃ kho me tvaṃ bhikkhu saṅkhittena chadhātuvibhaṅgaṃ dhārehīti.
mn140:33.2: satthā kira me anuppatto sugato kira me anuppatto sammāsambuddho kira me anuppattoti uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn140:33.3: accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yohaṃ bhagavantaṃ āvusovādena samudācaritabbaṃ amaññissaṃ
mn140:33.4: tassa me bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti.
mn140:33.5: taggha tvaṃ bhikkhu accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ āvusovādena samudācaritabbaṃ amaññittho
mn140:33.6: yato ca kho tvaṃ bhikkhu accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikkarosi tante mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma
mn140:33.7: vuḍḍhi hesā bhikkhu ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikkaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
mn140:34.3: na kho me bhante paripuṇṇaṃ pattacīvaranti.
mn140:34.4: na kho bhikkhu tathāgatā aparipuṇṇapattacīvaraṃ upasampādentīti.
mn140:35.1: atha kho āyasmā pukkusāti bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pattacīvarapariyesanaṃ pakkāmi.
mn140:35.2: atha kho āyasmantaṃ pukkusātiṃ pattacīvarapariyesanaṃ carantaṃ gāvī jīvitā voropesi.
mn140:36.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
mn140:36.2: yo so bhante pukkusāti nāma kulaputto bhagavatā saṅkhittena ovādena ovadito so kālakato
mn140:36.4: paṇḍito bhikkhave pukkusāti kulaputto paccapādi dhammassānudhammaṃ na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ viheṭhesi
mn140:36.5: pukkusāti bhikkhave kulaputto pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko tatthaparinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokāti.
mn140:36.7: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
